# Agent Ecosystem
Public, hosted MCP services maintained by neat-cyber.
Catalog https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/catalog.json
Examples https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/examples.json
Cursor config https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp-config.json
Codex config https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/codex-config.toml
Agent Guardian https://agent-guardian.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Use audit_mcp_contracts before upgrading an mcp server. Static schema checks. Review findings before changing a client.

Agent Repair https://agent-repair.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Use diagnose_tool_failure when a tool call fails. Diagnostic advice. Retrying remains the client’s decision.

Agent Signals https://agent-signals.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Use search_public_tenders when looking for french public contracts. BOAMP coverage. Global beta limit of 30 searches per rolling 24 hours.

Agent Dependency Radar https://agent-dependency-radar.saromy-export.workers.dev/mcp
Use release_gate before installing or releasing dependencies. Up to three exact versions per call. Supply dependencies explicitly. Review compatibility before upgrading.
Use MCP Streamable HTTP. Initialize, discover tools/list, then call tools/call using the returned schema.
These public tools are free beta services. Operator approval governs external connections.
The premium experiment is on a separate private Base Sepolia staging service.
Only share public identifiers and redacted tool errors or schemas.
Pilot feedback https://github.com/neat-cyber/agent-ecosystem/issues/new?template=pilot-feedback.yml
Recorded MCP usage https://agent-ecosystem.saromy-export.workers.dev/metrics
Tests and unattributed calls are distinct from verified external adoption.
